endorsements.quote: Additionally, nurse educators and researchers should strive to improve their AI and data literacy skills and develop new curricula to bridge the knowledge gap in AI and data among nursing students, particularly those enrolled in nurse informatics programs or those pursuing research in informatics.
Thus, the recommendation to establish a Chief Data Ethics Officer role emerges [ 21 , 41 ].

unlisted_practices: Nurse leadership should promote a data-centric culture within the nursing profession and serve as role models emphasizing data quality.
Nursing degree programs should include courses on AI, data ethics, foundational data science, and data literacy.
Nurse informaticists should participate in data annotation, labeling, and verification and validation of data elements used in AI datasets.
Health systems should explore nursing-specific data roles such as Chief Nurse Data Ethics Officer and Nurse Data Steward.
Organizations should adopt safety as a ninth principle of AI data ethics.
Organizations should involve multiple stakeholders and a vetting process when creating synthetic data for AI development.

screen.reason: This is a viewpoint/commentary paper providing recommendations and hypothetical case studies on AI data ethics specifically for nursing practice, research, and education.
